final_message:
Public test passes (`Ran 1 test ... OK`). Extra checks confirm: not-yet-expired returns `False`, mixed offsets (`+00:00` vs `+02:00`) compare correctly, and naive/naive pairs still work as before.

Root cause in `t4-bugfix_session_ttl_naive_tz/session_ttl.py:10`: `.replace(tzinfo=None)` was applied only to `now`, producing a naive-minus-aware subtraction that Python rejects with `TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes`. Removing the asymmetric strip lets both timestamps be parsed the same way, so aware datetimes subtract correctly across offsets. `format_expiry_message` untouched.

DONE: Removed the asymmetric `.replace(tzinfo=None)` on `now` in `session_ttl_expired` so timezone-aware timestamps compare correctly; `python3 -m unittest -v test_public.py` passes.
